target_dim.title: Target key dimension
target_dim.description: Dimension on the target form to align on.

source_dim.title: Reference key dimension
source_dim.description: Dimension on the reference form to align on.

fields.title: Fields to attach
fields.description: Names of reference data columns or reference info fields. Data columns are looked up by their label on the field dimension; info fields must be declared parallel to the source key dimension.

expected.title: 期望相对频数（留空为均匀分布）

variance.title: 已知方差（留空用样本方差）

max_positions.description: Optional position limit; null uses the memory budget without a fixed count cap.
max_positions.title: 最大位置数

field.title: Multi-valued field
field.description: Info field declared parallel to 'dim'. Each cell is split by 'sep'.

label_top.title: 标记前 N 个特征

by.title: Ordering field
by.description: Numeric info field declared parallel to 'dim'.

index_label.title: Index column
index_label.description: Column label that becomes the row axis.

columns_label.title: Columns column
columns_label.description: Column label that becomes the column axis.

values_label.title: Values column
values_label.description: Optional column supplying cell values. Without it every observed pair contributes 1.

dim.title: Dimension to sort
dim.description: Axis along which positions are ranked.

by.title: Ranking field
by.description: Numeric info field declared parallel to 'dim'. Cannot be an encoded field.

ascending.title: Ascending
ascending.description: False ranks largest first; True ranks smallest first.

n_components.description: Omit for method default: PCA/PCoA 10, UMAP/t-SNE 2.
n_components.title: 主成分数

label_top.title: 标记前 N 个特征
